items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Here’s an interesting one, the one with Link Chamberlain that Muse put out, with you and Link and Lyn Christie.

ctx.x: Yeah, but that’s released – I didn’t release it until ’80, ’81. That was the San Francisco M, M, and M group I was talking about. I had the tape. Finally, in ’81, I found Joe Haider and had to get a record out and so on. But that was done during the San Francisco time.
Lighten Up, Please! we’ve talked about with Pee Wee Ellis. Here’s an interesting one, the one with Link Chamberlain that Muse put out, with you and Link and Lyn Christie.
It’s Link’s record. That was Link’s record at a leader. It was his record to lead. We played a Wayne tune there.
